sources.name: Official public bid electrical schedules, secondary source

limits: Extraction-only public bid reference; --extract-only required by evaluation protocol.
One original full page; only one bounded table is keyed, other tables are context and unscored.
22 numeric facts across 11 scheduled equipped/spare rows; 16 total schedule positions with five prepared spaces.
Circuit numbers remain table-local positions, not source device tags.
Header AIC is not a per-breaker interrupting rating; no continuous current is inferred from trip.
Key is draft pending independent source-only QA. No implementation exposure, provider calls, parser runs, or predictions precede labels.
No configuration, generation, engineering approval or time-saving claim.
Only frame_a and trip_a are scored numerically; independently audited poles and panel-header AIC remain unscored. Source authority historical_reference_only; --extract-only is mandatory.
